commands.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskOutput = 'D:\Temp\combat-library-behavior-j75bzt8f\runs\baseline-L07'
$taskInput = 'D:\Temp\combat-library-behavior-j75bzt8f\baseline\skills\combat-director\SKILL.md'
$taskLog = & {
  '=== SKILL.md (full read) ==='
  Get-Content -LiteralPath $taskInput -Raw -Encoding UTF8
  '=== SHA256 ==='
  Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $taskInput -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Path, Hash | ConvertTo-Json
} 2>&1
$taskExit = if ($?) { 0 } else { 1 }
$taskLog | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $taskOutput 'lookup-1.txt')
exit $taskExit

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = 'D:\Temp\combat-library-behavior-j75bzt8f\baseline\skills\combat-director'
$taskTool = Join-Path $taskRoot 'scripts\library_tool.py'
$taskLog = & {
  python -B $taskTool search techniques --school '八卦掌' --query '白蛇吐信' --detail detailed --limit 4
  $script:taskPythonExit = $LASTEXITCODE
  '=== Hashes: executed script and internally loaded catalog; neither directly read in full ==='
  Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $taskTool, (Join-Path $taskRoot 'library\catalog.json') -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Path, Hash | ConvertTo-Json
} 2>&1
$taskLog | Tee-Object -FilePath 'D:\Temp\combat-library-behavior-j75bzt8f\runs\baseline-L07\lookup-4.txt'
exit $script:taskPythonExit

reads.note: 仅计算哈希；另由 Python -B 执行，没有直接阅读脚本正文。
由 library_tool.py search 读取并筛选；直接看到的是单项搜索结果，不是索引全文。

notes: 仅阅读冻结技能包、请求文件；未读取主仓库、其他快照、任务、研究或评估结果及记忆。
未联网、未生成媒体、未调用平台、未修改技能、未启动其他代理。
library_tool.py 由 Python -B 执行。索引只由脚本内部加载；搜索输出不记为直接完整阅读 catalog.json。
自有产物通过 apply_patch 写入，不作为输入证据重复登记。所有 shell 命令及其实际退出码列于 commands，输出对应 lookup-N.txt。
